text: - Every slice I read is self-contained the right way: Problem → Evidence (with **real file paths on master**) → Target state → Scope → **Out-of-scope** → Acceptance criteria → Verification commands. This is exactly the shape an agent can pick up cold and execute without re-discovery. [...] - **Tight doctrine↔tactics coherence.** The slices map 1:1 onto the ADR spine that just settled: READ slices → ADR-0070, WRITE slices → ADR-0071, starter slices → ADR-0069, and the ratchet mechanics (retired-symbol tests, "positive symbol test becomes a retired-symbol ratchet") are exactly ADR-0073's discipline. The queue *is* the ADR reset, executed.
